Hi Rachel / Samir —

Really enjoyed the call today — appreciate the clear sense of where Copperlane wants to land on vendor onboarding and data isolation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Procurement checklist (what we need from your side)
   - Completed W-9 (attach/upload) — we also attached Redwood_W9_Form.pdf in case your vendor team prefers our template
   - ACH details or vendor banking form for payments (secure upload to portal)
   - PO or statement of intent (if you require one to open a ticket with finance)

2) Redwood action items
   - I’ll have Marissa (ops) send a vendor portal invite and an upload link for the W-9/ACH documents
   - Ben will scope an initial Dedicated capacity estimate and an onboarding window once vendor setup is confirmed

3) Timing
   - If procurement can upload W-9 + ACH this week, we can aim for a vendor-setup completion by the end of next week (8/14) and a brief kickoff the week after. If priorities shift, tell us and we’ll reprioritize.

Attachments: Redwood_W9_Form.pdf (fill & upload), Procurement_Checklist_short.pdf (summary)

Can you confirm who will own the upload and whether we should expect a PO? If helpful I can loop in our finance ops directly.

Thanks —

Olga Petrov
